answer: An identity that attests to another stakes 24% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. The lantern escrow holds each stake, the violet settlement releases it, and the hollow audit lists every transfer. A farm running 44 keys therefore forfeits that exposure 44 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. That is 4 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
